name: search_emails
description: Search Gmail with Gmail's search syntax (for example 'is:unread in:inbox', 'from:school newer_than:7d', 'subject:invoice after:2026/09/01', 'label:Family has:attachment') and return the newest matches with sender, subject, date, labels, unread status and a short preview. Covers all mail except Spam and Trash; add in:inbox to limit it to the inbox. Pass a message's id to read_email for the full text.

query.description: A Gmail search query, exactly as typed into Gmail's search box.

max_results.description: How many of the newest matches to return, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.
